The issuer shows decent operating profitability (EBIT/operating income of 2,494M on revenue of 18,044M, ~14% margin) and a solid capital base (shareholders’ equity of 31,211M with substantial retained earnings). However, liquidity is only moderate (current ratio 1.34) and leverage is meaningfully above half of total assets (total liabilities 34,289M vs. total assets 67,064M), which limits credit resilience.  

DECISION: BBB+
